name: csr-companion
description: Claude Self-Reflect beside Claude: a pane that shows what your memory handed Claude this session, a side agent that asks "what if...?" when your past sessions give it a reason, and a heads up when Claude opens code that changed since you last worked on it

dreams.title: Dreams
dreams.description: While Claude works, CSR's dreamer asks one "what if...?" when its memory gives a reason. It looks only when CSR has something new, slows down when it finds nothing, and never spends more than 1 token for every 10 Claude spends.
